Chavrie Fennel Apple Salad
By: Corrinne
Published: Thursday, April 8, 2010 - 1:23pm

Ingredients




1 package (5.3 oz) Chavrie® goat cheese
2 ea. Gala apples
1 ea. Celery stalk
1 ea. Fennel bulb
1/2 teaspoon Lemon juice
1/2 cup Walnut pieces

Preparation

1 Remove core and slice apples. 2 Remove core and slice fennel. 3 Cross cut celery. 4 Mix apples, fennel and celery with lemon juice in a stainless steel bowl. 5 Fold in Chavrie®. 6 Serve on a bed of baby salad and top with walnut pieces.

About


A delicious and fresh salad! The crisp, sweet apples are just perfect with the fresh goat cheese.
